purpose: Authoritative terminology and language rules for the Local LLM Chat Bot interface.

zh.rule: 界面说明、按钮和状态使用中文。保留文件名、零件号、材料原文、模型名、类别官方名称和证据引用的原始语言。

en.rule: Use English for all interface copy. Preserve file names, part numbers, model IDs, original source excerpts and official class names.

de.rule: Die gesamte Oberfläche verwendet Deutsch. Dateinamen, Teilenummern, Modell-IDs, Originalzitate und offizielle Klassennamen bleiben unverändert.

copy_rules: Use sentence case in English and German UI text; do not use title case for ordinary buttons or labels.
Use concise action verbs for buttons: 选择 / Choose / Auswählen; 确认 / Confirm / Bestätigen; 查看 / View / Ansehen.
Do not translate model names, model IDs, file names, part numbers, OCR, PDF, token, or manufacturer identifiers.
Use the official Codebook class name verbatim wherever it is evidence or a classification result; do not translate the class name automatically.
For Chinese UI copy, use 装配体 instead of Baugruppe. For German UI copy, use Baugruppe. For English UI copy, use assembly.
Dynamic status and error messages must be assembled from translation keys and variables, never from hard-coded sentences in one language.
layout_rules: All labels must wrap naturally; no fixed-height control may clip a second line in Chinese, English, or German.
Buttons use content-aware minimum widths and may grow to two lines for German where necessary.
Cards may show a two-line summary before truncation; long paths use middle truncation rather than forcing a horizontal overflow.
Use a font fallback stack that supports Simplified Chinese, Latin scripts and German diacritics on Windows: Inter, Segoe UI, Microsoft YaHei, Noto Sans SC, sans-serif.
Every language must be checked at 100%, 125% and 150% Windows display scaling before release.
